info.name: eXeLearning
info.summary: Preview and edit eXeLearning .elpx packages in Nextcloud
info.description:
Provides a Nextcloud Files viewer for eXeLearning `.elpx` packages by rendering the internal `index.html` inside a sandboxed iframe.
The app registers a Nextcloud Viewer handler so `.elpx` files open in a modal with the package fully navigable: HTML pages, CSS, JavaScript, images, audio and video resolve from the package contents through a scoped Service Worker.
Optional features:
- `screenshot.png` thumbnails as Nextcloud previews. - "Edit with eXeLearning" action that opens the static eXeLearning editor bundled in the release package. Only installs from a source checkout need to fetch it with `make download-editor`.
This app is Nextcloud-native and does not depend on Google Drive.
